splitCtaSubtext: From Scoresby to Hawthorn, we bring vision, precision and quality to every brick laid and every wall raised.
aboutText: Keystone Builders brings over 15 years of hands-on experience to residential and commercial projects throughout Scoresby and greater Melbourne. We combine old-school craftsmanship with modern project management to deliver spaces that are functional, compliant, and built to last. Whether it's a bespoke family home or a complex medical fitout, we treat every job with the same focus on quality and clear communication.
servicesText: From the first survey to the final coat of paint, Keystone Builders manages every stage of your project. We specialise in residential new builds, home extensions, and tailored commercial fitouts across offices, retail, medical, and industrial sectors.

services.title: Residential New Builds
services.desc: Custom-designed homes built to suit your block, your lifestyle, and your budget. We handle everything from slab to handover across Melbourne's eastern suburbs.

services.title: Extensions & Renovations
services.desc: Expand your living space without compromising character. Seamless additions, second-storeys, and modern upgrades tailored to existing architecture.

services.title: Office & Retail Fitouts
services.desc: Smart, stylish commercial interiors that reflect your brand and maximise workflow. From boutique stores to corporate offices in Scoresby and surrounding areas.

services.title: Industrial & Factory Fitouts
services.desc: Heavy-duty solutions designed for safety, efficiency, and compliance. Warehouses, production floors, and logistics hubs built to perform.

services.title: Medical & Aged Care Fitouts
services.desc: Specialist environments meeting strict hygiene and accessibility standards. Dental clinics, sports medicine centres, and aged care facilities delivered with care.

services.title: Project Management
services.desc: End-to-end oversight of timelines, trades, and compliance. We coordinate councils, engineers, and certifiers so you don't have to.
